lines.text: Born in 1912 on the banks of the Danube, son of a wealthy Serbian family
settled in Dubrovnik. Lawyer, doctor of law, polyglot, gambler, seducer.
During the Second World War, he worked for two secret services at once.
Which one was he really deceiving?
They say he inspired Ian Fleming’s James Bond.
That he staked a fortune at baccarat, with someone else’s money.
That his code name, “Tricycle”, owed more to his private life
than to his talent as a spy.
That he could have changed the course of the war, had anyone listened.
What is true, what is exaggerated: Monsieur X has his version.
